title: NPCDataStoreV1
description: Consolidated schema for Quest: Warrior Dragon Non-Player Characters (NPCs), combining spatial placement, sprite roles, facing direction, dialogue, and interaction behaviors.

additionalProperties.description: List of NPCs located on a specific map scene (e.g. 'kol-1f', 'tantegel-castle-2f').

col.description: Grid column position on the map.

row.description: Grid row position on the map.

desk_tile.description: Optional counter desk coordinates for merchants/innkeepers.

speaker.description: Display name of the speaker during dialogue.

pages.description: Dialogue pages spoken by this NPC.
